en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a classroom scene. A group of young children, several of whom are barefoot, stand and sit in front of an older woman (presumably a teacher) who is seated on a chair next to a lectern or easel displaying pictures. The classroom has a wooden floor, plain walls decorated with a few posters or pictures, and a single light bulb hanging from the ceiling. The atmosphere and fashion suggest an early 20th-century setting.
